sourceProjection.basis: The scanned Fundacio Caixa Catalunya visitor brochure was visually inspected after rotating its sideways plans: pages 2 and 3 contain top-down plans, while no geometry is extracted directly from the full scans.

Four plan crops were extracted from the 2480 by 3507 brochure scans after a lossless 90-degree rotation and without rescaling. Their vector surface paths follow the brochure's printed visitor-area colour fills and retain the reviewed courtyard, roof-void and skylight holes. Entrance a/b glyph and arrow bounds are removed before segmentation; a reviewed 3-pixel kernel on every plan joins only scan halftone.

review: The source is a public third-party scan of an undated historic visitor brochure visibly issued by Fundacio Caixa Catalunya; it is not represented as a current map. The brochure explicitly marks the terrace, Espai Gaudi attic and fourth-floor Pedrera Apartment as areas included in the visit, and its entrance plan identifies Carrer Provenca and Passeig de Gracia access. Current official La Pedrera accessibility and practical-information pages independently confirm that the ground floor, rooftop, attic and fourth-floor apartment remain visitor levels, but they publish no downloadable plan. For each used crop, one vector surface was traced from the largest coloured visitor-area component. A 3-pixel close on every plan joins scan halftone only; entrance a/b letters and arrows are excluded before segmentation, and enclosed gaps below reviewed thresholds of 10000, 20000, 5000 and 10000 pixels are label/halftone gaps, while larger source-shaped courtyard, roof-void and skylight holes remain. Neutral ink at RGB max 100 and chroma <= 15 supplies architectural linework; overprinted black wayfinding badges are masked tightly. Attic and roof use a 5-pixel structural classifier so thin stair and rooftop-object ink remains flat detail.
limitations: 四层平面来自未标日期的旧 Fundacio Caixa Catalunya 访客折页，不是当前运营地图；现官网仅核验这些楼层仍属参观范围。
彩色楼面严格跟随折页标出的参观区域与孔洞；入口 a/b 字母、箭头和外部路线墨迹在分割前排除，没有手工补画庭院或屋顶大板。
黑色电梯、楼梯、服务和信息图标遮住了少量原始线稿；图标已排除为几何，其下被遮挡的墙线保持未知。
主层临时展厅、地下礼堂、私人住宅与非开放区域未纳入本模型；外立面停靠点也未绑定到室内图。
各层以独立来源图展示，不推断统一测量配准、当前单向路线或当日开放状态。
旧折页的服务图标保留在原标注位置，不代表现行服务设施；庭院为位置标注，不用整层楼面代替庭院边界。

research.finding: Public scan visibly branded Fundacio Caixa Catalunya supplies orthographic plans for the terrace, Espai Gaudi attic, fourth-floor Pedrera Apartment and entrances; the scan itself is undated and not hosted by the current institution.

Current official page states that tactile plans are present on the ground floor, rooftop, attic and fourth-floor apartment, and confirms those visitor levels; no downloadable floor geometry is published.
Current official practical page confirms the two courtyards, Pedrera Apartment, Whale Attic and Warrior Rooftop as the visit's principal spaces.
Current official events catalogue provides room and event descriptions but no complete orthographic visitor plan.
The official easy-to-read visitor guide was downloaded and visually inspected; it supplies route semantics and photographs but no complete orthographic floor plan.

Barcelona Municipal Archive record CAT-AMCB-Q127_Eix105261905_R0048 supplies a 1906 third-floor project plan, but it is not the current fourth-floor visitor apartment and therefore remains research evidence only.

rules.reason: Exact vectorization of the brochure's largest coloured entrance-level visitor-area component; the large enclosed source void remains a hole.

flatRects.reason: Reviewed interior of the printed stair flight; its surrounding enclosure remains structural

rasterLayers.reason: Reviewed neutral architectural ink from the historic entrance plan; coloured area fills are separate source surfaces and overprinted service badges are excluded.
